metadata.title: AnagramFrenzy — Isomeric Word Discovery Game
metadata.subtitle: Enter any English word, discover how many isomeric dictionary words exist, and guess them all or shelve for later!
metadata.value_proposition: An interactive word puzzle where players enter any English word to see the exact count of valid dictionary anagrams (isomeric words), jump into the guessing arena to type and unlock each rearrangement, and either complete the set or shelve the word for later.

personas.name: Word Puzzle Enthusiast
personas.context: Testing vocabulary depth by finding every single letter rearrangement of challenging words
personas.motivation: Unlocking 100% of a word's isomeric family without missing obscure rearrangements
personas.pain_point: Not knowing how many valid dictionary anagrams exist for a chosen word

personas.name: Casual Vocabulary Explorer
personas.context: Playing quick rounds and shelving tough words to revisit later
personas.motivation: Seamless ability to shelve partially solved words and resume them anytime
personas.pain_point: Getting stuck on one hard word with no way to save progress and try another word

parameters_schema.name: Count Base Word
parameters_schema.guidance_ranges: 0 = Strict Anagrams (exclude original word), 1 = All Isomeric Permutations (include original word)

items.name: LISTEN (Classic 6-Letter Isomeric Family)
items.summary: Rearrange the 6 letters of LISTEN to form all 5 other valid dictionary words.
key_facts: Other isomeric words: silent, enlist, tinsel, inlets, elints
items.persona_notes: Ideal starter word for Word Puzzle Enthusiasts.
items.quiz_question: Which of these is a valid dictionary anagram of LISTEN?
items.quiz_explanation: SILENT uses the exact letters E-I-L-N-S-T.

items.name: EARTH (5-Letter Isomeric Family)
items.summary: Rearrange EARTH into its other valid 5-letter English dictionary words.
items.quiz_question: Which of these is an isomeric word for EARTH?
items.quiz_explanation: HEART is formed by rearranging the exact letters of EARTH.

items.name: STOP (4-Letter High-Density Family)
items.summary: A 4-letter word with 5 additional common English rearrangements.
key_facts: Includes: tops, pots, spot, post, opts
items.quiz_question: Which word is an anagram of STOP?

items.name: LEAST (5-Letter Power Family)
items.summary: One of the richest 5-letter anagram clusters in English.
key_facts: Includes: slate, stale, steal, tales, teals, tesla
items.persona_notes: Perfect for testing shelving and resuming.
items.quiz_question: Which word is an isomeric rearrangement of LEAST?
items.quiz_explanation: SLATE uses the exact letters A-E-L-S-T.

items.name: CARET (5-Letter Precision Set)
items.summary: Rearrange C-A-R-E-T into cater, crate, react, trace, and more.
key_facts: Includes: cater, crate, react, trace, recta
items.quiz_question: Which word is an anagram of CARET?
items.quiz_explanation: REACT uses the exact letters A-C-E-R-T.
